outcome: Relative abundance of different bacterial taxa
Microbial functions (vitamin B6 metabolism, taurine and hypotaurine metabolism, phosphotransferase system, starch and sucrose metabolism)
finding: Infants born by cesarean section showed altered gut microbiota composition and development during the first 3 months of life compared to vaginally delivered infants, including decreased Bacteroides and Parabacteroides and increased Firmicutes/Bacteroidetes ratio.
followup_time: 5 days, 8 days, 11 days, 2 weeks, 4 weeks, 6 weeks, 7 weeks, 2 months, and 3 months
